title: WING GUNDAM ZERO CUSTOM EW
summary: Pretty solid kit so far with a lot of improvements from other Daban models. However, I think this is a result of them copying MJH model which is known for their good joints design. I am not quite sure but I will double-check by borrowing one later.
pros: Good joints and fit pretty well.
Can pose a lot of stances better than other Daban gundams without losing an arm or a leg.
Come with many parts so you can replace the armor color into grey/white one.
cons: Seems to be a perfect copy of a copy (MJH and Bandai) without any specific characteristic
Come with only two hand sets.
Trimming is a huge issue. A lot of nubs to be scrubbed off.
